LanguageData.LP_BullRush.label: bull rush
LanguageData.LP_BullRush.description: Charge straight up to 8 cells toward the target. The first enemy hit takes 15 × body size blunt damage, is knocked back 2 cells and stunned for 1 second. Stops on hitting a wall, building or someone in the way, without damaging buildings. Cooldown 1 day.
